metadata.purpose: Patient-oriented mixed single-document retrieval evaluation set for Cardiomyopathies_2023, revised to reduce section-title leakage and overly broad multi-hop questions.
metadata.section_annotation_policy: Questions should be phrased as realistic clinical or patient-facing questions rather than as section-title prompts. Source annotations should still use the most specific section or set of sections needed to answer each question; avoid adding parent sections when the answer is confined to a child section.
metadata.question_style_policy: Questions should read like realistic clinical doubts or patient consultations. Multi-hop questions should express one clinical doubt and should not enumerate all source sections or management stages.
metadata.revision_note_v5: Questions judged less clinically plausible or too broad in v4 were rewritten to sound like focused consultation questions; corresponding gold sections were narrowed where the revised question no longer required broad chapter-level retrieval.
metadata.audit_summary: Checked against Cardiomyopathies_2023.pdf. Most annotations are adequate; two source lists were corrected: CM_STD_08 and CM_MH_02.
